title: GoldenSetQuestionSchema
description: Standard schema for AI Proposal Assistant ground-truth evaluation benchmark.

id.description: Unique identifier for the test question (e.g., GT-001)

rfp_id.description: Identifier of the source RFP (e.g., RFP-HEALTHCARE-01, RFP-FIN-02)

question.description: The exact question asked by the solution architect or bid reviewer

expected_answer.description: The ground-truth factual answer that the AI must produce

expected_source.description: Exact document name, section number, and page citation

is_not_found.description: Set to true for negative trap questions where the AI must refuse to answer and return 'not found in sources'

reviewer_notes.description: Notes or corrections from pre-sales reviewers (Rukul / Prince)
